decision: Do not promote: single prespecified confirmation does not establish robust VP8 gain and repeats positive VP9 median signs. No further repeat requested.
scope: Isolated x64 mask-reduction experiment, PGO off; C intentionally skipped. Compare only same-job ASM/base/current and retain all CPU labels.
vp9_liveness_limit: Changed generic kind 4 path is reached via VP9 vertical4-dual filtering; current byte-entry has one 10 ms sample, while the changed helper body has no directly attributed sample. UV paired helper has no VP9 caller. Unchanged nonflat filter samples do not establish the cause of the public VP9 median regression.
limits: First run EPYC7763 and confirmation EPYC9V74 are separate CPU contexts; do not pool absolute times or compute cross-CPU subtraction.

All 22 semantic fields and every public/profile allocation sample checked separately; see arrays for any outlier.
